title: §7[§rS§7]§r Enter
description: The server player activates §aEDIT MODE§r to gain a view of the client player's home. While editing, the server player can break or place blocks (§7including breaking/placing multiple at once & middle clicking to gain a block§r), as well as open the inventory to §aDEPLOY§r Sburb machinery and a §bCRUXITE ARTIFACT§r punched card. To exit §aEDIT MODE§r, press §aJ§r.
The client player must use the machinery in order to alchemize a §bCRUXITE ARTIFACT§r. It is recommended you figure this out yourself, but if you need one, there is a tutorial on the following page.
1. Break Cruxtruder Lid and turn wheel to extract Cruxite Dowels.
2. Place Cruxite Dowel and Pre-Punched Card into the Totem Lathe and carve the dowel using the button on the top.
3. Use cursor on any creature or block to prototype your Kernelsprite.
4. Place your carved Cruxite Dowel into the alchemiter, interact with it to alchemize your Cruxite Artifact.
